title: Veggie Ground Taco Stuffed Tomatoes with Cheddar, Lettuce & Yogurt

steps.text: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add veggie ground and spices to the skillet; cook, breaking it apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly 5-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes. Slicing from the top down, cut tomatoes into wedges, being careful to not cut completely through to the bottom; sprinkle with salt.
Wash and dry lettuce. Stack leaves, one on top of the other, halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips.
To serve, divide tomatoes between plates. Stuff with veggie ground and top with cheese, lettuce, and yogurt. Enjoy!
